# llm-gateway-lite

> Minimal WSGI LLM gateway: OpenAI-compatible chat endpoint over injected providers, hashed virtual keys, per-key model lists, rate and monthly token caps, content-free audit events Python package `trysac-llm-gateway-lite`, import name `llm_gateway_lite`, MIT licensed,
> Python >= 3.10, no runtime dependencies.
